name: No-Frost Air Conditioning & Heating

meta_description: No-Frost Air Conditioning & Heating, Ellicott City MD. AC and furnace repair, replacement, heat pumps, indoor air quality and water heaters across Howard, Baltimore and Carroll counties since 1971. Same- or next-day service.
headline: Heating and cooling fixed the same day you call, by the family that has done it since 1971.
subhead: No-Frost is a family-owned, veteran-operated, woman-led HVAC company in Ellicott City with over five decades in Howard County. Same- or next-day service and estimates, a two-year labor warranty on installations, and all major brands.

why_lead: Three things customers mention again and again.

why.title: Same-day response
why.text: Reviewers describe calling Friday afternoon and being fixed by 4:30, and a Saturday visit in the middle of a heat wave.

why.title: Reasonable, fair pricing
why.text: Customers call the pricing very reasonable, and describe a technician driving back to the office for a part to save them money.

why.title: Straight answers
why.text: Reviews praise clear explanations of the repair and easy fixes suggested instead of upsells.

reviews.text: No Frost saved the day for us! Our A/C had been broken for several days because a different contractor flaked out on us. We called No Frost, and they were able to see us the same afternoon, and Clint resolved the problem in just over an hour. Everyone we interacted with was polite and friendly. The repair process was explained clearly, and the price was very reasonable.
reviews.author: Joel S.

reviews.text: I called at 2:30pm on a Friday and my AC was diagnosed and repaired before 4:30. No-Frost has always been our go-to, but this experience was better than ever. Thanks, folks!
reviews.author: Denise

reviews.text: AC unit broke on Friday night and despite a heat wave coming in a few days, No-Frost was able to send Eric to my house same day on a Saturday. He was able to quickly diagnose the issue and fix it (even drove back to the their office to get a part to save us money). Pricing is very reasonable. Thank you and we will plan to use No-Frost again for any AC/Heating issues!
reviews.author: David
